results.title: Storage failure during client-create is not reported as persisted success
results.steps: Block Storage.setItem; perform client-create; inspect feedback and stored state.
results.expected: The operation clearly reports that changes are unsaved or storage failed; persisted state is unchanged.
results.actual: Misleading feedback after persistence failure: Client created. Add a project when you are ready.

results.title: Storage failure during project-create is not reported as persisted success

results.expected: The operation clearly reports that changes are unsaved or storage failed; persisted state is unchanged.
results.actual: Misleading feedback after persistence failure: Project created. Choose apps or create your own.

results.title: Two tabs must not silently overwrite each other
results.steps: Open two same-origin tabs before edits; create a different client in each; inspect stored data.
results.expected: Both clients survive, or a clear conflict prevents overwriting the first tab.
results.actual: Runtime.callFunctionOn timed out. Increase the 'protocolTimeout' setting in launch/connect calls for a higher timeout if needed.

results.title: Structurally invalid saved state has a usable recovery path
results.steps: Load schema 1 with a project missing its draft object.
results.expected: Show usable recovery feedback; do not crash to a blank application.
results.actual: No application or recovery UI rendered for malformed stored project.

results.title: Unrecognized saved schema is not silently replaced
results.steps: Load a synthetic workspace with a future schema number.
results.expected: Keep original data and show recovery/version feedback rather than silently creating an empty workspace.
results.actual: Unknown schema was replaced without visible recovery/version feedback.

results.title: Initial storage denial still renders the workspace
